title: Graph Memory Transformer (GMT)
abstract: arXiv:2604.23862v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We investigate whether an explicit learned memory graph can replace the Feed-Forward Network (FFN) sublayer in a decoder-only transformer while preserving the surrounding autoregressive architecture. In the proposed graph Memory Transformer (GMT), a memory cell routes token representations over a learned bank of centroids connected by a learned directed transition matrix, while causal self-attention remains unchanged. In the base v7 instantiation, each of 16 transformer blocks contains 128 centroids and a 128 x 128 edge matrix. Each cell uses gravitational source routing and token-conditioned target selection to return a gated displacement from the estimated source memory state toward the target memory state, rather than a retrieved value. translated_abstract: 我们研究了一种显式的可学习记忆图能否替代仅解码器（decoder-only）Transformer中的前馈网络（FFN）子层，同时保留周围的自回归架构。在所提出的图记忆Transformer（GMT）中，记忆单元通过一个由学习得到的有向转移矩阵连接的可学习质心库来路由token表示，而因果自注意力机制保持不变。在基础v7实例中，16个Transformer块中的每一块包含128个质心和一个128×128的边矩阵。每个记忆单元采用引力源路由（gravitational source routing）和基于token条件的目标选择，返回一个从估计的源记忆状态指向目标记忆状态的门控位移（gated displacement），而非检索到的值。由此得到的仅解码器语言模型拥有8220万可训练参数，且不含密集的FFN子层；而用于对比的密集GPT风格基线模型拥有1.03亿参数。该模型能够稳定训练，并展现出质心u……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出图记忆Transformer（GMT），用可学习的显式记忆图（128个质心加有向转移矩阵）替代仅解码器Transformer中的FFN子层，在因果自注意力不变的情况下，以更少的参数量（82.2M对103.0M）实现稳定训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Graph Memory Transformer (GMT), which replaces the FFN sublayer in a decoder-only transformer with an explicit learned memory graph (128 centroids connected by a learned directed transition matrix), achieving stable training with fewer parameters (82.2M vs. 103.0M) while keeping causal self-attention unchanged.
